label: End-of-episode low-value fixation/choice: D1 after no reward, or GO choosing a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and GO, never at D2 (it is silent whenever a state or action input is present). It is almost entirely an end-of-episode unit: zero activity before trial ~45, 83% of mass in trials 90-99, and 85% of mass when the value head is in its lowest bin (value < 5.22). Value falls as the episode runs out, so value is the observed correlate of the time remaining. Within that regime it fires at D1 when the previous trial went unrewarded (rewarded D1s are nearly silent: 0.2% of mass) and at GO when the agent is about to choose a1 (a1 GO rate is 2-3x that of a2). The GO action is the agent own upcoming choice, which is legitimate, so the predicate uses no unobservable future variable. A plain value < 5.22 at D1/GO gives F1 0.44; adding the reward and choice conditions raises dev F1 to 0.67 (P 0.70, R 0.64, mass recall 0.80). Recall is weaker in the lowest activation quartile; the largest activations come at late-episode D1s after a run of unrewarded trials. Using ep_trial >= 85 in place of value gives higher mass recall (0.87) but lower precision.
